note: Each entry ties one documented POD Go fact to a preset that DEMONSTRATES it. 'rule' matches an id in registry/rules.json. Demonstrators are reference/teaching presets, NOT published presets (those live in presets/). Where possible a demonstrator is the known-good base (base_preset) plus one minimal, documented edit; otherwise it points at a real export already in the repo. status is 'verified' ONLY when the fact was jointly confirmed with Clifton today AND has an accompanying preset here; everything else is 'unverified' (see docs/knowledge/verified.md). Nothing here asserts hardware viability of a block combination.

provenance_kinds.factory-export: an untouched Line 6 export (base preset or a data-presets dump)
provenance_kinds.derived-illustrative: base preset + one minimal documented edit, byte-preserving
provenance_kinds.published-preset: a curated preset from presets/ (hardware-tested library)

demonstrations.demonstrates: An empty/free block is exactly {"@position": N}; a healthy jailbroken-capable preset exposes 10 blockN slots.
demonstrations.observe: dsp0.block2/block3/block8/block9 are each {"@position": N} with no @model; blocks 0-9 = 10 slots.

demonstrations.demonstrates: snapshot0-3, footswitch, and controller sections and their internal shape; these are the keys a blank-slate strip removes.
demonstrations.observe: tone.snapshot0-3 (per-block on/off + controllers), tone.footswitch.dsp0.blockN (@fs_* keys), tone.controller.dsp0.blockN (@controller/@min/@max).

demonstrations.demonstrates: @type per built-in role: Volume 0, Wah 0, FX Loop 5, EQ(_STATIC) 0, Amp 1, Cab 2.
demonstrations.observe: block0 VolPan @type 0, block1 Wah @type 0, block4 FXLoop @type 5, block7 EQ_STATIC @type 0, block5 Amp @type 1, block6 Cab @type 2.

demonstrations.demonstrates: The built-in preset-EQ uses HD2_EQ_STATIC_* (matches the eq built-in prefix HD2_EQ_); free-block EQ effects use HD2_EQ* WITHOUT the underscore and are not built-ins. Both coexist in one preset.
demonstrations.observe: block8 = HD2_EQ_STATIC_Simple3BandStereo (built-in) alongside free effects HD2_EQParametricStereo, HD2_EQLowCutHighCutStereo, HD2_EQGraphic10BandStereo, HD2_CaliQStereo, etc.

demonstrations.demonstrates: A forward slash in meta.name is stored on disk escaped as \/ (an optional JSON escape decoding back to /).
demonstrations.edit: meta.name value "New Preset" -> "In\/Out"; every other byte identical to the base.
demonstrations.observe: Raw file shows "name" : "In\/Out"; decoded the name is In/Out. Diff against the base is one line.

demonstrations.demonstrates: meta.name has a hard 16-character cap; a hand-edited over-length name is silently truncated to 16 on import (not rejected).
demonstrations.edit: meta.name value "New Preset" -> "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJ" (20 chars); every other byte identical to the base.
demonstrations.observe: Import to POD Go / POD Go Edit: the stored/displayed name truncates to the first 16 chars "0123456789ABCDEF".

demonstrations.demonstrates: A published preset ships blank-slate: free blocks empty, no footswitch/controller assignments (snapshots may remain).
demonstrations.observe: All free blocks are {"@position": N}; no tone.footswitch or tone.controller sections (contrast the base, which has both).

demonstrations.demonstrates: A missing blockN slot silently lowers the free-block count below the intended value.
demonstrations.observe: dsp0 is missing block5, so only 9 slots exist and free_blocks = 5 despite the '6bl' intent.

demonstrations.demonstrates: A preset can carry a duplicate built-in block (two Volume blocks) — a plausible cause of breakage.
demonstrations.observe: Two HD2_VolPan* blocks in dsp0; podgo.classify reports duplicate_builtins {volume: 2}.

demonstrations.demonstrates: POD Go tolerates a trailing comma that strict JSON parsers reject; our tools recover and flag it.
demonstrations.observe: podgo.load_pgp returns parse status 'recovered-trailing-comma' for this file.

demonstrations.demonstrates: With Volume or FX Loop kept, a 7th free block is a phantom the UI shows but cannot assign (the 7 assignable-block ceiling).
demonstrations.observe: 7 free blocks while the FX Loop is present; per the ceiling the extra slot is unassignable (registry status: broken).

demonstrations.demonstrates: A genuine 7 free blocks requires removing BOTH Volume and FX Loop.
demonstrations.observe: No Volume and no FX Loop present; 7 free blocks, EQ + Amp kept.

demonstrations.demonstrates: Removing both Amp and Cab tends to collapse the chain to 8-9 slots and reliably breaks.
demonstrations.observe: no-amp-and-cab taxonomy; fewer than 10 slots; registry status: broken (representative of the folder).
